title: Momentum by Google and YourStory to bring India’s founders, investors, and policymakers into one room in New Delhi
summary: Momentum by Google, in collaboration with YourStory, puts India’s startup future on one stage, with the people who will build, fund, and shape it.
llm_summary: Momentum, a new event series launched by Google in partnership with media platform YourStory, will convene India’s startup ecosystem—founders, investors, and policymakers—under one roof in New Delhi. The gathering aims to showcase emerging ventures, spark funding and policy discussions, and help shape the country’s next wave of tech innovation.
